dataset: SonifyEarth Excluded Records & Quality Downgrade Provenance Audit
policy_statement: Zero source records are deleted. All flashes excluded by fatal quality flags (0x55) or conservative South Atlantic Anomaly (SAA) interval overlap (0x03), and all observation intervals reclassified to UNKNOWN, are preserved here with full source identifiers and reason codes.
